gnPlan.newNovaOption: nova_active_web_chromium_profile=true: PROPOSED new immutable build flag, not upstream GN arg. No runtime off-switch.
gnPlan.preserveRequiredCEFArgs: F14 GetRequiredArgs incl Widevine/CDM-related assertions. Do not silently disable required CEF graph dependencies; reject or separately review incompatibility. No proprietary CDM binary/autodownload accepted in app distribution.

pipeline: Approve isolated builder and source pins; fetch exact CEF + Chromium compatible tag/commit, record repository tree hashes.
Pin root depot_tools to chosen DEPS-derived commit, disable self-update only within task process environment; record Python/Git/GN/Ninja/CIPD instance IDs and byte hashes.
Resolve DEPS and CEF's existing patch.cfg series; include all CIPD/cloud toolchain inputs by content hash; never execute unrecorded moving hooks.
Apply ordered Nova conceptual patch series only after CEF upstream series; fail on offset/conflict or missing security hunk; emit applied-series digest.
Generate GN, capture requested AND resolved args/build graph/link inputs; reject unknown/unused options and incompatible mandatory CEF flags.
Build app-local CEF and dedicated host targets with pinned clang-cl/lld + Windows headers/libs; no stock engine fallback.
Two clean builds in controlled independent workspaces; compare unsigned PE/resource/packaging hashes, diagnose any variation. Signing/packaging timestamps separate.
Emit build manifest, binary/module hashes, gate/profile digest, SBOM/notices; archive symbols privately.
Run mandatory native security and BrowserPort/Block05 suite; human review; only exact artifacts receive certificate.

reproducibility.repeatableNotBitReproducible: Pinned inputs permit repeatability; bit-for-bit requires clean rebuild comparisons of unsigned binaries and normalized packaging. Existing -ffile-compilation-dir/PDB flags do not prove full determinism.

distribution.shape: App-local fixed CEF DLL/resources/subprocess binary; explicit private profiles; module identity attest before content; no installer/service/global networking/CA.
distribution.standardBinarySubstitution: Rejected; missing build profile/gate hash -> fail closed.
distribution.licensing: CEF/Chromium BSD plus per-DEPS third-party notices/SBOM. CDM/proprietary codecs redistribution not inferred from compiling CEF.
